title: Chapter 1027 Big Right And Wrong
content:
Chapter 1027 Big Right And Wrong

"I once read Han Zi's book, which said that if you are vertical, you can unite the weak to attack one strong person; if you are horizontal, you can use one strong force to attack all the weak ones."

"But there is another sentence at the end, which is not the reason for holding the country! To set up false claims, to borrow external forces to achieve their own selfish ends, regardless of the interests of the country!"

Kuai Che was pushed and knelt down under the beacon of Gaoliu City. The guards immediately retreated. Fusu, who was wearing a white fox fur and a he crown on his head, sat in front of him. Although he had been marching in the grassland and wind and frost for many days, he still He still mustered up the energy to have the final conversation between the two of them.

"Now I understand why Shang Jun, Han Zi, and other Legalists don't like those who talk freely."

Fusu pointed at Kuai Che: "You had already plotted rebellion when the world was at peace. You once persuaded me in Fan Yang to rebel against Qin and become independent from overseas. Then you alienated my father and Hei Fu, and your plan to coax me into colluding with the Xiongnu failed. Now you plan to do it again." Let the two Qin armies continue to be hostile."

"Exaggerating the facts to drive a wedge between father, son, monarch and ministers, without any bottom line and by any means necessary."

"You are the star that brings trouble to the world!"

"King Zhao is wrong."

Kuai Che raised his head and smiled:

"We Zongheng people are not Yinghuo planets."

"Those who are strategists have no ability to wield a blade, and no one has the wealth of gold in their position. The reason why we can succeed is because of one thing."

He held out a finger: "That's how evil human nature is!"

"As a baby, the parents raise it, but the son grows up and resents it. When the son grows into a man, his support is poor, the parents are angry and criticize him. Son and father are close relatives. If this is the case, let alone between ordinary people and between countries? What they call trust is nothing more than interests. Yinghuo is not in the sky, nor was it created by the wise. He is in the hearts of the people, filling the world, and everyone's heart!"

Politicians are great at analyzing people's hearts and are best at exploiting the weaknesses in human nature.

So Zhang Yi said to King Huai of Chu, what should I say? The king sincerely listens to his ministers and seclusion has made an appointment with Qi. The ministers asked him to offer a land of six hundred miles, so that Qin’s daughter could become the concubine of the king’s dustpan. Qin and Chu would marry women. , has long been a country of brothers, taking advantage of the greed in the heart of King Huai of Chu.

After the battle of Lantian, he persuaded King Huai of Chu that the Qin army would be in danger within three months of attacking Chu, but Chu could wait for the princes to save him for more than half a year. This was because their power was not comparable, so he deceived Chu. King Huai accepted the land and asked for peace, which was to take advantage of King Huai of Chu's fear of Qin.

Then Su Qin lobbied King Qi Min and persuaded him to proclaim himself emperor and destroy the Song Dynasty. He gradually led to rebellion and separation from relatives and besieged by the princes, taking advantage of King Qi Min's arrogance.

Yao Jia said that Zhao Wangqian was taking advantage of his disbelief and suspicion of Li Mu.

All the emotions in people's hearts are all flaws in the eyes of strategists.

As long as there is, the strategist can use words to amplify it, create rifts in allies, and make monarchs and ministers alienated!

This is Kuai Che's specialty!

"King Zhao thinks he can be an exception? Now that you have become king, can your Haidong garrison and Liaodong soldiers forgive Heifu for his preference for Chen Ping and his cruelty to Liaodong?"

He teased:

"Is Hei Fu an exception? Now the situation is clear. Hei Fu has killed Hu Hai, chased a group of young masters, killed the Meng brothers, and monopolized power. He is named Qin Xiang, but he is actually a Qin thief. The still living young master Fusu is him. The biggest thorn in your side, the thorn in your flesh, you will not be allowed to summon the king! I personally went north this time to solve your big problem!"

"Indeed it cannot."

Fusu nodded:

"I will never forget what Chen Ping did to Liaodong."

For two years, Chen Ping, who was in Jiaodong, brought too much trouble to Liaodong. Whether it was colluding with Lianyan, Zhao, and Dai to hinder Fusu from advancing westward, or constantly sending Wei Man and other bandits to drag Liaodong back, allowing Fusu to retreat. For two years, they were unable to leave this three-thirds of an acre of land, and more than tens of thousands of people from eastern Liaoning and western Liaoning died in vain.

Fusu smiled helplessly: "On the one hand, I had to deal with the persuasion from my subordinates, and on the other hand, I also tried to convey the proposal to Heifu, but nothing happened. He turned around and announced that I was dead. It was difficult for me to guess what he wanted... "

"After so many things happened, he and I can't really trust each other as before. On the contrary, we have many more grievances and grievances."

But Fusu changed his tone and said loudly: "But even so, some things cannot be made easier!"

"That's a big deal!"

"The descendants do not seek Xia, and the barbarians do not disrupt China. It is a great mistake to help the Rong and Di to attack the Xia!"

"This is what I understood more than ten years ago when I was the supervisor of the army and I, Li Xin, and Hei Fu fought against the Huns in Helan Mountain! Once I do it, I will be a sinner for the ages!"

Kuai Che handed over his hand and said, "This is the reason why King Zhao refused to help the Xiongnu and even traveled thousands of miles to send his troops to attack."

"Kuai Che was wrong about this..."

"But now that King Zhao has defeated the Xiongnu and expressed his intentions to the world, but next, how will King Zhao deal with Heifu? How will the three counties of Liaodong, Liaoxi, and Youbeiping deal with themselves?"

Fusu looked at Kuai Che: "Then according to your plan, how should we deal with it?"

Kuai Che pointed to the east: "Don't hesitate any longer, and immediately turn around and go back to Youbeiping. The Liao people are all riding lightly, and the black man can defeat the Xiongnu. The chariots and horses are exhausted and they can't catch up. When spring comes, he will take the Liaodong people with him and migrate to the sea. In the east, Heifu will secure the Central Plains and will not be able to raise a large army to attack, and King Zhao will be able to become the independent king of a country until the times change..."

Fusu smiled: "What a clever plan. It's exactly the same as when Fan Yang persuaded me to betray my father. Kuai Che, do you really like to see the world divided? If I follow your plan, there will be one more person in the Central Plains. The enemy, the situation is worse than when we conquered Haidong. Heifu and I have completely turned against each other. The merchants have stopped and turned to building warships. The rest and recuperation that the people of Guandong long for will no longer be realized. "

"Let me tell you, colluding with the barbarians to invade the Xia is a big mistake."

"Then, let the world be unified as soon as possible, the people will be happy, and the head of Guizhou will be rich, that will be a great thing!"

Kuai Che was stunned and wanted to stand up, only to find that his hands were tied by the rope on the wooden stake behind him.

He could only scratch his head and say: "You don't care about the lives of tens of thousands of soldiers under your command and hundreds of thousands of people?"

Kuai Che lost his initial confidence and became hysterical, shouting:

"Have you forgotten the seven hundred years of the Qin Dynasty? Are you going to hand over the great achievements left by the First Emperor of Qin and the countries built by the ancestors of the past generations?"

"Fusu, are you trying to be a sinner with the surname Ying!? How will you face your ancestors after death?"

"sinner……"

Fusu repeated the word, but smiled and said: "You are right, I was once a sinner."

"Not only the sinners with the surname Ying, but also the sinners of the whole world!"

He looked at his calloused hands that had been holding swords and spears for two years: "Because of a single thought on my part, all the advantages in my hands were ruined, and the situation eventually fell in the worst direction."

"Those careerists, remnants of the Six Kingdoms, and lobbyists are the most hoped-for chaos!"

"Do you think that I rose up in Haidong and led the garrison troops to quell the rebel king because I wanted to restore the country? To be a hero?"

"Yes, there is a little bit of this idea, but more importantly, I do all this just for one thing."

He expressed his original intention: "Atonement!"

"However, my abilities are limited and I am constrained by Chen Ping. I can only slightly pacify eastern Liaoning and western Liaoning. I have tried my best to preserve the livelihood and tranquility of the people in the two places. Speaking of which, Fusu is really useless. In this matter, I Far inferior to Heifu, he has defeated the Six Kingdoms, but I am still spinning in circles."

He laughed at himself: "In the end, all this I did seemed redundant."

Fusu shook his head: "That's all. Now that Jiuzhou is about to be settled, if I listen to you and become the sinner who continues to disrupt the world, my resurrection will really be the opposite!"

Kuai Che was stunned.

He once talked about Zhao Xie, Peng Yue, Han Guang, and Mao Dun. Even many years ago, he even designed the drama of "Hei is the one who destroyed Qin", which successfully made the first emperor of Qin suspect Hei Fu, alienated the emperor and his ministers, and caused great chaos in the world - —At least Kuai Che feels it’s his own credit.

Even if this big move fails in the end, Kuai Che will be proud of it and be proud of his lobbying skills.

But now, Kuai Che feels extremely frustrated in front of Fusu...

The first time he lobbied Fusu failed, firstly because he was deliberately testing him, and secondly because he thought Fusu was loyal and filial.

But now, Fusu has witnessed betrayal and separation, and seen the killings in the world. He started from Haidong, has gone through many hardships, and his behavior is very different from that of the past. Kuai Che thought that he had changed and became someone he could persuade...

Nostalgia for power, confusion about the future, fear of the enemy, worry for the people under his command, anger at the unfair situation, doubts about old friends, and pride that makes it difficult to bow down and be a subordinate... These emotions are not the same for Fusu. few!

But Kuai Che tried his best, but in the end he couldn't persuade Fusu.

Now he understands.

Fusu also has a certain belief that he cannot shake!

"The grievances between Hei Fu and I have not yet become a dead end. The two of us should resolve it ourselves."

"But it's definitely not based on suspicion and attack! It's definitely not based on the alienation of a traitor like you!"

Fusu said while looking outside, as if waiting for something.

"So Fusu, are you going to be killed in the Heifu camp by yourself?"

Kuai Che only thought it was ridiculous. How could there be such a person in this world?

A character who chooses to give up and commit suicide?

"What kind of person is Mr. Hei? If he can kill the Meng brothers, he can also kill you! No mercy!"

Kuai Che raised his head and laughed: "I laughed at Qin Shihuang, what a heroic figure he was. He was kind but greedy, he was cannibalistic when he succeeded, and he was ruthless in doing things. How could he give birth to such a kind and soft-hearted son like you!"

"That's right, I have a kind heart and I can't change it."

Fusu stood up and waved people outside to come in.

"But my hands are already covered in blood and are no longer soft..."

"Especially for those sinners who have committed more serious sins than me, lest the world be in chaos!"

The guards bowed in front of them, and Fusu asked them: "After talking like this, is the fire burning up?"

"It's booming," the guard reported.

In the open space outside Fengsui, a huge pottery tripod is boiling with boiling water, and the heat is rising...

"good."

Fusu looked at Kuai Che, who was shivering from the cold, with mucus congealed on his face. It was hard to tell whether his expression was fearful or fearful, and said with a smile:

"Mr. Kuai has been freezing for several days. He has no clothes or brown clothes. It is extremely cold. It is really degrading. Let him warm up!"

Facing such a villain like Kuai Che, Fusu did not express hysterical hatred and reprimand. He was only polite as the eldest son. He stretched out his hand as if to invite Kuai Che to a banquet.

The men in Liaodong are not very gentle. Some pull their arms, some lift their thighs. Some people complain that the pottery tripod is not big enough. I am afraid that they have to chop off the limbs before they can be stuffed in...

Fusu just watched them go away gracefully:

"Second and third sons, help Mr. Kuai and cook!"
